title: Chiebito Kyousoukyoku ~ The Victors' Space Odyssey - Darwinism Capriccio
description:
Track 2 from The Victors' Space Odyssey, a Touhou music CD-style album complete with Renko and Maribel story.

This song has a spooky air to it. To me, it feels like the kind of music that's perfect for when you're at the end of a roadtrip, arriving in a big city at night.

Originally ported for Superfamicompo 3.
